description: Replace the Connectivity tab's vertical peer list with a Cloud Map-style two-column flow: the focused card highlighted at the left, its drawn peers in a column at the right, joined by SVG edges, each card carrying a service icon, a state chip and its cost, the inferred tail folded behind a count, and a legend naming the edge kinds. Depends on FEAT-001 for the shared presentation and for compactConnectivityFlow. Covers plan.md items 7-12.
steps: In frontend-app/src/components/Cost/ResourceConnectivityTab.tsx add module constants CARD_W = 300 and CARD_H = 84, a `const [showInferred, setShowInferred] = useState(false)` reset everywhere setExpanded(false) already fires (followPeer and both Back buttons), `const drawn = showInferred ? shown : stated`, `const hiddenInferred = showInferred ? 0 : inferred.length`, and a memoised `compactConnectivityFlow({ peers: drawn, hidden: hiddenInferred, focusW: CARD_W, focusH: CARD_H, peerW: CARD_W, peerH: CARD_H })`. Leave peerCostIds derived from `shown`, not `drawn`, and comment WHY: the fold is presentation, so it must not change which ids are priced, the cost cache key, or what the trim banner counts — and an expand then shows figures already fetched. Change nothing above the final return beyond this.

Replace the border-l rail and the two PeerGroup renders, inside the existing 'Connected to (n)' block, with: an overflow-x-auto scroller wrapping a positioned surface of exactly style={{ width: placed.width, height: placed.height }} carrying role="group" and an aria-label naming the focus; an aria-hidden <svg> sized to that surface with one <FlowEdge kind="connects" dashed={peer.derived || peer.external} trunkX={placed.trunkX}> per drawn peer anchored focus-right-edge-mid to peer-left-edge-mid, plus one idle dashed edge to the more row when there is one; the focus card as an absolutely positioned div at placed.focus using nodeClass(true), aria-current="true" and an aria-label, carrying TypeIcon, the label, a StateChip for focus.state beside type and facts, the shortened focusCostId and MoneySlot on its own bottom line; one card per drawn peer at the peer's own x/y/w/h using peerCardClass({ dashed: peer.derived || peer.external }) carrying TypeIcon, the relation (with the '\u2190 ' prefix when inbound) IMMEDIATELY followed by the label with nothing between them, a 'type \u00b7 location \u00b7 n connections' meta line, the peer's StateChip where index.byId.get(peer.id) has one (read with the model's own fieldOf/detailOf), and either MoneySlot or, for an external peer, 'Not drawn on the map'; <MoreButton row={placed.more} onClick={() => setShowInferred(true)} noun="inferred connection" expanded={showInferred} /> when placed.more is non-null; and <EdgeLegend /> unpositioned below the scroller.

Keep followability exactly as it is: a peer is a real <button> only when !peer.external && locate(index, peer.id), and anything else is a plain <div> — never a disabled button, because a disabled button still answers getByRole('button', { name }) and 'not offered as something to follow' is the tested contract. Keep each card's hoverText(...) title over exactly the lines it displays.

Move the focus card's variable-length prose out of the fixed geometry without changing its wording: focus.warnings, the differsFromChangeTab reconciliation sentence, the costsFailed banner and the closing footnote stay as paragraphs below the flow area. Add a muted '2 stated \u00b7 16 inferred' breakdown beside the existing 'Connected to (18)' count when any peer is inferred. Leave the 'Show all N connections' toggle and the 'Costs shown for the first N of M connections' banner exactly where and as they are.

Re-express, without deleting, the two list-shaped assertions in frontend-app/src/components/Cost/__tests__/ResourceConnectivityTab.test.tsx: slot.closest('div.rounded-xl') in "says it on the focus card too" becomes slot.closest('[aria-current="true"]') (same guarantee: the sentence is bound to the focus card, not merely present), and anything depending on the 'Stated' / 'Inferred from details' headings is rewritten against the fold. Update that file's header comment to say the tab draws a flow, not a list.

Add five new cases to the same file over a fixture matching the measured real shape — two stated peers (one priced, one not) and sixteen inferred SSM:SSMMESSAGES:TARGET-ID peers, i.e. CONNECTED TO (18) of which 2 cost money: (1) inferred collapsed by default, both stated labels rendered, no inferred label rendered, 'Show 16 more inferred connections' is a button, AND the folded inferred ids are still in the first cost request; (2) clicking it renders the inferred labels and removes the button; (3) one svg path[d] per drawn edge before the expand and more after it, queried off document because the drawer is a portal; (4) exactly one [aria-current="true"], carrying the focus resource's text and its figure; (5) the scroller carries overflow-x-auto and its surface a pixel width of 300 + 84 + 300, so a peer column past a phone-width drawer's right edge is reachable without the drawer growing.

Re-read the component against the behaviours that had to survive and fix any drift: the five unavailable states in their exact order and wording; lazy (nothing fetches until active, accountId passed as null to useCurInsight while unselected); in-flight never rendered as failure, each loading flag still repeating its query's own enabled condition; AWS-only gating untouched (GcpCostPage.tsx:353 and AzureCostPage.tsx:275 still pass connectivity={null}); re-rooting on a peer with Back and Back-to-root and an unchanged drawer header; accessibility (real buttons, aria-selected on the tab strip, keyboard reachable, aria-label where visible text is insufficient, svg aria-hidden).
Record in the FEAT's findings field anything the convergence step needs: the final CARD_W/CARD_H if they changed, and any test assertion that had to be re-expressed beyond the two named above.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/components/Cost/__tests__/ResourceConnectivityTab.test.tsx` passes, including every pre-existing case that was not re-expressed — in particular the followed-peer accessible names /attached to prod-web-01/ and /accesses prod-web-01/, 'Show all 40 connections', the 26-id and the 99-of-150 cost assertions, 'Not drawn on the map' with no matching button, and all four MoneySlot sentences.

The five new cases pass: inferred collapsed by default with its count, expand reveals them, edges rendered, the focused card marked with aria-current, and the flow surface declaring a 684px width inside an overflow-x-auto scroller.
No '$0.00' is ever rendered for an absence; 'no cost attributable' and 'cost not attributable to this resource alone' remain distinct sentences.
`npx tsc` is silent and `npm test` is green.
`npx vitest run src/components/CloudMap` still passes, i.e. the Cloud Map page did not regress.
GcpCostPage.tsx and AzureCostPage.tsx are unmodified, and no backend file (ResourceIdResolver, ResourceCostJoin, CurAdvancedMetricsService, any controller) is touched.
verification: cd /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New && git status --porcelain | cat  (expect no change outside frontend-app/src/components and .agents/tasks/connectivity-tab)
findings:
DONE. `npx vitest run src/components/Cost/__tests__/ResourceConnectivityTab.test.tsx` => 39 tests passed (34 pre-existing, 5 new). `npx vitest run src/components/CloudMap` => 5 files / 38 tests passed, unchanged. `npx tsc` silent (note: a cold tsc on this tree takes >2 min; it needs a timeout above 120 s). `npm test` => 1561 passed, 7 failed in 3 files — src/pages/__tests__/BillOpsAdminDashboardPage.test.tsx, src/components/Sidebar/__tests__/cloudk8sSidebar.test.tsx, src/components/Sidebar/__tests__/loginAsAccountDashboard.test.tsx. All 7 are PRE-EXISTING and unrelated: they fail identically when run alone, the cause is `TypeError: localStorage.setItem is not a function` from ThemeContext.tsx:19 under those files' own globals mock, and none of them imports anything this task touched. git status also shows frontend-app/src/pages/CloudShellPage.tsx, xamops-service CloudShellSocketHandler.java and xamops-service application.properties dirty — not touched by this feature, already dirty from another task. FINAL CARD DIMENSIONS: CARD_W = 300, CARD_H = 84, exactly as planned — no growth was needed. placed.width is therefore 684 (300 + CFLOW.COL_GAP 84 + 300) and trunkX is 338 (trunkFor(300)), which the new scroller case asserts as the literal string '684px' off the surface's inline style. Peer row pitch is CARD_H + CFLOW.ROW_GAP = 94. TEST ASSERTIONS RE-EXPRESSED (one, as named in the FEAT): - 'says it on the focus card too': slot.closest('div.rounded-xl') -> slot.closest('[aria-current="true"]'). Same guarantee, new marker. - The 'Stated' / 'Inferred from details' headings turned out to be asserted NOWHERE in the file (grep for Stated|Inferred|rounded-xl|closest returns only the line above), so nothing else had to be rewritten against the fold. The file's header comment now says the tab draws a flow, not a list. No pre-existing assertion was deleted or weakened. DELIBERATE DEVIATIONS FROM plan.md items 8-9, both for copy honesty: 1. The costsFailed banner stays ABOVE the flow area (where it already was), not below it with the other prose. Its own wording is 'so no figures are shown below', and moving it under the figures would make the sentence point the wrong way. focus.warnings, the differsFromChangeTab sentence and the closing footnote DID move below the flow, wording untouched. 2. The peer meta line uses `peer.peerCount > 1 && ' connections'` rather than `> 0` (the old tooltip's test). '1 connections' is both ungrammatical and a count of the edge the reader is already looking at; this matches what ResourceConnectivityFlow.tsx does on the Cloud Map. The card's hoverText now carries exactly the three lines it displays plus peer.id, which the 300px card has no room for — same choice the Cloud Map's peer tooltip makes. THINGS THE NEXT CHANGE WILL BREAK IF IT IS NOT CAREFUL: - The peer card renders relation (a block ) then label (a

) as ADJACENT siblings with nothing between them, and the StateChip sits on the THIRD line next to the meta text. Putting the chip, the 'inferred' badge or anything else between relation and label renames the card: the accessible name stops matching /attached to prod-web-01/ and /accesses prod-web-01/ without a word of visible copy changing. There is a comment saying so at that spot. - An unfollowable peer (external, or no locate()) is a plain

with the same classes; it is never a disabled button. - `placed` is a useMemo keyed on a joined `relation\u0000id` string, so it sits ABOVE the component's early returns with the other hooks. It cannot move below them. - peerCostIds is still derived from `shown`, never from `drawn`; the fold changes nothing about the request, the cache key or the trim banner. The 'folds the inferred tail' case asserts all 16 folded ids are in the FIRST cost call (19 ids), and the expand case asserts costs was called exactly once. - New test helpers in the spec file: redisFetchers(), flowSurface() (getByRole('group', { name: /connects to/ })) and edgePaths(), which counts path[d] inside the FIRST svg of the surface only — counting off `document` would also count every Iconify icon's path, including the more-button's own. - The new fixture is the measured shape: focus i-0redis000000001 'xamops-prod-db-redis' with 2 stated peers (volume priced $120.40, app instance unpriced) and 16 inferred peers produced by ONE detail key 'SSM:SSMMESSAGES:TARGET-ID' whose value is 16 comma-separated node ids — that is how the model turns one key into 16 derived links, and it is worth knowing before writing another derived-peer fixture. - EdgeLegend is rendered as the plan asked, so this view shows a blue 'contains' swatch even though it draws no containment edge (the containment path is the text breadcrumb; the folded-row connector is the grey idle one). Dropping that swatch would mean giving the shared legend a prop, i.e. editing the Cloud Map's legend, which was out of scope here.
